facts.title: Parmesan Roasted Broccoli with Balsamic Drizzle
ingredients: 1 pound (16 ounces) broccoli florets, cut into bite-sized pieces (from 2 pounds or about 1 ½ bunches of broccoli)
1 to 2 tablespoons thick balsamic vinegar or balsamic glaze**
Lemon zest from ½ to 1 lemon, preferably organic
Pinch of red pepper flakes (omit if sensitive to spice)
Pinch of flaky sea salt or kosher salt
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
